item.title: Attorney General Ellison recovers $18.5 million in taxpayer dollars from Partners in Nutrition in civil settlement
item.description:
Publication Date: September 24, 2026

Lawsuit and settlement resolve year-long civil investigation into PIN regarding false claims made to the State for child nutrition funds, in violation of False Claims Act
